# Button group

> Joined button group for toolbars, split actions, and segmented controls.

This file matches the installed `button-group` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/button-group.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/button-group.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `button`
- `core`
- `track-highlight`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/button-group-knobs`: `buttonGroupKnobs`, types `ButtonGroupKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/button-group`: `ButtonGroup`, `ButtonGroupText`, `ButtonGroupSeparator`, types `ButtonGroupTextProps`, `ButtonGroupProps`, `ButtonGroupSeparatorProps`

## Composition

### Joined actions

```tsx
<ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroupText />
  primary action
    <Button />
  <ButtonGroupSeparator />
  secondary action
    <Button />
</ButtonGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupSeparator, ButtonGroupText } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button-group";

export function PrimitiveButtonGroupExample() {
  const [alignment, setAlignment] = useState<"left" | "center" | "right">("center");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4">
      <ButtonGroup aria-label="Text alignment">
        <Button variant="surface" active={alignment === "left"} aria-pressed={alignment === "left"} onClick={() => setAlignment("left")}>
          Left
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="surface"
          active={alignment === "center"}
          aria-pressed={alignment === "center"}
          onClick={() => setAlignment("center")}
        >
          Center
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface" active={alignment === "right"} aria-pressed={alignment === "right"} onClick={() => setAlignment("right")}>
          Right
        </Button>
      </ButtonGroup>

      <ButtonGroup aria-label="Share link">
        <ButtonGroupText>https://</ButtonGroupText>
        <Button variant="surface">control-ui.dev/r</Button>
        <ButtonGroupSeparator />
        <Button variant="surface">Copy</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>

      <ButtonGroup orientation="vertical" aria-label="Item actions">
        <Button variant="surface">Open</Button>
        <Button variant="surface" disabled>
          Duplicate
        </Button>
        <Button variant="surface">Open in new window</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>

      <ButtonGroup indicator="none" aria-label="Static actions">
        <Button variant="surface">Undo</Button>
        <Button variant="surface">Redo</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```
